test_cases.description: GET /api/v1/audit with audit:read permission returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing events from both hub_audit_events and agent_audit_events ordered by timestamp.

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp := GET('/api/v1/audit', headers); assert resp.status == 200; body := parseJSON(resp.body); assert len(body.events) == 3; assert body.events[0].timestamp <= body.events[1].timestamp <= body.events[2].timestamp; assert body.has_more == false

property_tests.description: For any hub mutation handler with a non-nil Emitter, the HTTP response status and body are identical whether Emit succeeds, fails, or the Audit field is nil.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For each mutation type (workspace create/update/archive/delete/sync, merge submit/complete/fail, patch create/delete, rebuild enqueue/complete/fail, secret/variable CRUD, git push): sample 10 valid requests; for each request, run the handler with (a) a succeeding Emitter, (b) a failing Emitter, (c) a nil Audit field
property_tests.invariant_check: assert response.status is identical across all three configurations; assert response.body is identical across all three configurations; assert no panic occurs in any configuration

property_tests.description: For any valid audit query response with has_more=true, decoding next_cursor yields a valid {ts, id} JSON object, and using it in a subsequent request returns the next page without duplicates or gaps.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Insert N events (N sampled from [101, 200, 500, 1000]) into hub_audit_events with distinct timestamps; issue GET /api/v1/audit?limit=100 repeatedly following next_cursor until has_more=false; collect all returned event IDs
property_tests.invariant_check: assert total events collected == N; assert no event ID appears more than once; assert events are in monotonically non-decreasing timestamp order across all pages; assert each next_cursor decodes to valid base64url JSON with 'ts' and 'id' fields

property_tests.description: For any event returned by GET /api/v1/audit, hub events have source='hub' with non-null hub-specific fields and null agent-specific fields; agent events have the inverse.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Insert M hub events and N agent events (M, N sampled from [1, 10, 50]); query GET /api/v1/audit with no filters; iterate all returned events
property_tests.invariant_check: for each event where source=='hub': assert actor_id != null AND actor_type != null AND resource_type != null AND resource_id != null AND action != null AND run_id == null AND node_id == null AND session_id == null AND archetype == null; for each event where source=='agent': assert run_id != null AND actor_id == null AND actor_type == null AND resource_type == null AND resource_id == null AND action == null

property_tests.description: For any active SSE connection, at least one heartbeat frame is delivered within every 30-second window, ensuring the 60-second stale timeout is never triggered by the heartbeat interval alone.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Connect an SSE client; observe heartbeat frames over a 90-second window; record timestamps of all heartbeat frames received
property_tests.invariant_check: assert for every 30-second interval within the observation window, at least one heartbeat frame was received; assert the maximum gap between consecutive heartbeat frames is less than 60 seconds; assert heartbeat frame event type == 'heartbeat' and data.timestamp is a valid ISO 8601 UTC string

property_tests.description: For any sequence of SSE connection attempts, the number of concurrently active connections never exceeds AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS, and any connection attempt that would exceed the cap receives HTTP 503.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Set AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS to K (sampled from [1, 2, 5, 10]); concurrently attempt K+5 SSE connections with valid auth; record HTTP status codes for each connection attempt
property_tests.invariant_check: assert exactly K connections receive HTTP 200 with Content-Type text/event-stream; assert at least 5 connections receive HTTP 503 with body {error: 'too many SSE connections'}; assert sseManager.activeConnections never exceeds K at any point

property_tests.description: For any transcript response for a given run_id and node_id, messages are ordered strictly by ascending timestamp with no reordering or deduplication.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Insert N trace events (N sampled from [1, 5, 20, 100]) for a fixed run_id and node_id with randomly ordered timestamps; query GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/runs/:run_id/transcript?node_id=:node_id
property_tests.invariant_check: assert len(body.messages) == N (no deduplication); assert for all i in [0, N-2]: body.messages[i].timestamp <= body.messages[i+1].timestamp (ascending order)

property_tests.description: For any handler package with an Audit field set to nil, no nil pointer dereference or panic occurs and the handler behaves identically to a handler with no Audit field configured.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: For each handler package (workspace, merge, carrypatch, secrets, gitserver): sample 5 valid mutation requests; run each request with Audit=nil
property_tests.invariant_check: assert no panic occurs for any request; assert response.status matches the expected success status for each mutation type; assert response.body matches the expected success body

property_tests.description: For any event emitted when one or more per-client SSE channels are full, the Emitter.Emit call returns without blocking regardless of per-client channel state.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Connect K SSE clients (K sampled from [1, 5, 10]); fill each client's per-client channel to capacity (256 events); emit M additional events (M sampled from [1, 10, 50]) via Emitter.Emit; measure elapsed time for each Emit call
property_tests.invariant_check: assert each Emitter.Emit call completes in less than 10 milliseconds; assert no Emit call blocks for more than 10 milliseconds; assert total elapsed time for M Emit calls is less than M * 10ms

edge_case_tests.description: When Emitter.Emit returns an error during a workspace mutation, the mutation HTTP response is unaffected and the error is logged but not propagated.
preconditions: A workspace handler config is initialised with a mock Emitter that always returns an error
An authenticated Echo context is available
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: mockEmitter.returnError = errors.New('simulated failure'); response := invokeCreateWorkspace(cfg, validRequest); assert response.status == 201; assert response.body does not contain 'error'; assert logOutput contains 'simulated failure'

An unauthenticated Echo context is set up (no auth info)
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: ctx := unauthenticatedEchoContext(); invokeCreateWorkspace(cfg, ctx); event := mockEmitter.capturedEvents[0]; assert event.actor_id == ''; assert event.actor_type == 'system'; assert no panic occurred

The Store is configured to return an error on query

edge_case_tests.description: GET /api/v1/audit without authentication returns HTTP 401 before executing any query.

edge_case_tests.description: GET /api/v1/audit with limit exceeding 1000 clamps the effective limit to 1000 and returns HTTP 200 with at most 1000 events.

edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: resp := GET('/api/v1/audit?limit=9999', headers); assert resp.status == 200; body := parseJSON(resp.body); assert len(body.events) <= 1000

edge_case_tests.description: GET /api/v1/audit with no filters and no cursor returns the most recent 100 events ordered by timestamp descending.
preconditions: DuckDB temp-file instance is initialised with hub_audit_events containing 150 events at distinct timestamps
An authenticated caller with audit:read permission is available
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: resp := GET('/api/v1/audit', headers); body := parseJSON(resp.body); assert len(body.events) == 100; for i in range(len(body.events)-1): assert body.events[i].timestamp >= body.events[i+1].timestamp

edge_case_tests.description: GET /api/v1/audit with since after until returns HTTP 200 with an empty events array rather than a DuckDB error.
preconditions: DuckDB temp-file instance is initialised with hub_audit_events containing events
An authenticated caller with audit:read permission is available
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: resp := GET('/api/v1/audit?since=2026-09-02T00:00:00Z&until=2026-09-01T00:00:00Z', headers); assert resp.status == 200; body := parseJSON(resp.body); assert len(body.events) == 0; assert body.next_cursor == null; assert body.has_more == false

edge_case_tests.description: Transcript handler skips unrecognized trace event types and continues building the transcript from remaining events.
preconditions: DuckDB temp-file instance is initialised with agent_traces containing events of types: session.init, unknown.type, assistant.message
An authenticated caller with audit:read permission is available
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: resp := GET('/api/v1/workspaces/ws-1/runs/run-uuid/transcript?node_id=node-uuid', headers); body := parseJSON(resp.body); assert len(body.messages) == 2; roles := map(body.messages, m => m.role); assert 'system' in roles; assert 'assistant' in roles; assert no message with role == 'unknown.type'

edge_case_tests.description: GET /api/v1/events when the SSE connection limit is reached returns HTTP 503 with JSON body {"error": "too many SSE connections"}.
preconditions: SSE connection manager is initialised with AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=2
Two SSE clients are already connected
An authenticated caller with audit:read permission attempts a third connection
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: setEnv('AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS', '2'); connectSSE(client1); connectSSE(client2); resp := GET('/api/v1/events', headers); assert resp.status == 503; body := parseJSON(resp.body); assert body.error == 'too many SSE connections'

preconditions: Echo router is initialised with audit routes registered
No authentication token is provided
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: resp := GET('/api/v1/events', noAuthHeaders); assert resp.status == 401; assert resp.headers['Content-Type'] does not contain 'text/event-stream'

preconditions: Echo router is initialised with audit routes registered

edge_case_tests.description: When a per-client SSE channel of 256 events is full, the oldest event is dropped, the new event is enqueued, and the drop is logged at debug level.
preconditions: SSE connection manager is initialised
One SSE client is connected with a per-client channel at capacity (256 events buffered)
The client is not reading
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: fillClientChannel(client, 256); emit newEvent; assert client.channel length == 256; assert client.channel does not contain originalOldestEvent; assert client.channel contains newEvent; assert debugLog contains 'dropped'

edge_case_tests.description: When an SSE client disconnects, the connection manager detects context cancellation, deregisters the client, and releases the per-client goroutine and channel.
preconditions: SSE connection manager is initialised
An authenticated SSE client is connected to GET /api/v1/events
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: initialCount := sseManager.activeConnections; connectSSE(client); assert sseManager.activeConnections == initialCount + 1; client.disconnect(); waitForCleanup(100ms); assert sseManager.activeConnections == initialCount

edge_case_tests.description: When an SSE connection has had no reads for 60 seconds, the connection manager closes it, deregisters the client, and releases associated resources.
preconditions: SSE connection manager is initialised with stale-connection timeout of 60 seconds
An authenticated SSE client is connected but stops reading
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: connectSSE(client); stopReading(client); wait(61 * time.Second); assert sseManager.activeConnections == 0; assert client.connection is closed

edge_case_tests.description: When the SSE broadcast channel is full, the Emitter drops the event and logs at debug level rather than blocking.
preconditions: SSE connection manager is initialised with a full broadcast channel
The Emitter is wired to the SSE broadcaster
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: fillBroadcastChannel(sseManager); start := time.Now(); emitter.Emit(ctx, hubEvent); elapsed := time.Since(start); assert elapsed < 10ms; assert debugLog contains 'dropped'

edge_case_tests.description: When AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS is set to a non-integer or negative value, the SSE connection manager falls back to the default limit of 100 and logs a warning.
preconditions: AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS is set to 'not-a-number'
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: setEnv('AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS', 'not-a-number'); manager := NewSSEManager(); assert manager.maxConnections == 100; assert warnLog contains 'AF_SSE_MAX_CONNECTIONS' or 'invalid'

edge_case_tests.description: When the SSE broadcaster goroutine panics, the connection manager recovers, logs the error, and restarts the broadcaster goroutine.
preconditions: SSE connection manager is initialised and running
The broadcaster goroutine is configured to panic on the next event
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: sseManager.injectPanic = true; emit event; wait(100ms); assert sseManager.broadcasterRunning == true; assert errorLog contains 'panic' or 'recovered'; emit anotherEvent; assert SSE clients receive anotherEvent

edge_case_tests.description: When the Store or SSE connection manager is nil at route registration time, the process panics at startup with a descriptive message.
preconditions: Echo router is initialised
Store is nil
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: assert panics with descriptive message when RegisterAuditRoutes(router, nil, sseManager) is called; assert panics with descriptive message when RegisterAuditRoutes(router, store, nil) is called

edge_case_tests.description: When writing an SSE frame to the HTTP response writer returns a non-nil error, the per-connection goroutine unregisters the client, logs the error at debug level, and exits without waiting for context cancellation or stale-connection timeout.
preconditions: SSE connection manager is initialised with at least one registered client
The per-connection goroutine is running and the client's response writer is configured to return an error on the next Write or Flush call

input.action: SSE frame write fails (broken pipe / client reset)

edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: conn := connectSSEWithFailingWriter(errWriter); wait(10ms); assert sseManager.activeConnections == 0; assert debugLog contains write error message; assert goroutine exited within 50ms of the write failure (not 60s stale timeout)

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test: workspace create mutation emits a hub.workspace.create audit event that is stored in DuckDB and broadcast to connected SSE clients.

hub_audit_events table contains one row with event_type='hub.workspace.create', resource_type='workspace', metadata containing git_url and branch
SSE client receives an 'audit_event' SSE frame with data matching the emitted HubEvent within 1 second of the mutation

has_more is true
